summary: Workflow: audit, threat model, secure code review, privacy review and remediation plan.
intents: run a full security assessment of this repository
do an end-to-end appsec review and give me a remediation plan
assess our service for security and privacy risks before launch
combine a threat model with a code-level security review
produce a prioritized security findings report for this codebase
prerequisites: written authorization for the system in scope

steps.goal: Map the codebase, dependencies, secrets and container configuration
Identify assets, trust boundaries and the most likely threats
Check the code paths behind each high-priority threat for vulnerable patterns
Check personal-data flows, retention and exposure
Write a findings report ordered by severity with owners and fixes

done_when: Each finding has evidence, severity, CWE where relevant and a fix
